headline: Congress named a New York City post office building after Corporal Juan Mariel Alcantara.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 90 Vermilyea Avenue in New York, New York, as the "Corporal Juan Mariel Alcantara Post Office Building." It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
